aiGuidance.summary: The words srs-web's editors show a person and teach an agent: one ui-feature record per feature, one container per editor or screen. Read the identity record first; it holds the purpose, the structure is below.
aiGuidance.navigationHints: The root container has no sections; areas are the other containers, found by their name (container list, not navigation): essay, essay-home (front page), site, merge-from-file. Each is the help dialog's order for that editor. Features are com.semanticops.help/ui-feature; feature_id is a stable slug (area.name), placement ui means on screen, concept means an idea only; there are no lifecycle states or relations. shell.* records are shared and members of several containers. New features go in the editor's container and need a matching data-feature in the app; tests/help-contract.test.ts fails otherwise. Words are data: edit through record_update or the CLI, never the JSON files.
